notes: Proposed contract fixtures, not a runtime, installed package, qualified adapter, or proof that a workflow executed.
valid is JSON Schema shape expectation only; expected_semantic_valid is a normative expectation, not a claim that a semantic compiler ran.

Invalid cases are independent mutations for isolated tests, not additional immutable versions to register beside the positive examples. Resolve their unchanged dependencies from the positive fixture registry.
Eight root workflows have is_scenario=true; child workflows are ordinary reusable components.

fixture_json_v1 is UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False), with no trailing LF. The fixture domain has ASCII object keys and safe integers, no floats. This is not a general RFC 8785 implementation.

Every immutable ref digest hashes the declared payload bytes, not the pretty-printed bundle. Package files form a virtual inventory of those payloads. The top-level package manifest and detached signature are excluded from self-inventory; no signature is supplied.
External dependencies carry real descriptor digests, but no executable or provider qualification. Unknown isolation and missing wakeup remain unsupported.
RedactionProfile describes a derived redacted view; it does not mutate sealed originals. Pattern matching is not a complete secret-exposure prevention guarantee.
The policy retention days and wait duration are example choices, not product SLA values. Human-decision payload is not an Action Approval or Grant.
Core schema resources are exact local-$ref closures extracted from protocol.schema.json. Rebuild fixtures after changes to referenced definitions.
